entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 36805 of 2024
Applicant :- Munia Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Abhishek Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned
Aga for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
123 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 304 B Ipc and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station
Phoolpur, District Varanasi, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased.
4. He further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to crush injuries and actually she died due to impact of the running train and therefore, it appears that either it is a case of suicide or accident.
Munia Devi vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98939737/
1 5.

entities.text: Munia Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicant is lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is having no previous criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 6.6.2024.

6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter in law of the applicant died within four years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that deceased died due to impact of the running train and applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for both the parties and the fact that deceased died due to impact of the running train and applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and applicant is lady and in the present matter, she is in jail since 6.6.2024, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Munia Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 12.11.2024 Ankita  Munia Devi vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98939737/
